aboutMe.text: I am a fullstack developer building web applications and native apps – from the interface through the API to the database. For almost a year I have been maintaining Pulsify with its native app, dashboard and Hono backend. Alongside that I am building my own products under the byButterfly brand, from product analysis to the finished app. Before that, nine years in specialist retail with daily customer contact: I know how people search, what they really need and where they get stuck – and that goes into every interface and API I build. What counts for me is not the latest technology but the solution behind it: well thought out, user-friendly and still maintainable years later. That is how products are built that are a win for both sides: real value for the users, measurable benefit for the company.
aboutMe.collaborate: I look forward to creating something great together!

skills.introduction: Across many completed projects I have acquired a wide range of skills. I keep expanding them continuously to keep up with the latest requirements.

projects.text: The following projects are an excerpt from my past work.

pulsify.descText: Planning app for going out: events and places in Austria's cities. One sentence is enough, Pulsify AI turns it into a plan with its own chat and keeps everyone on track. Web app, iOS and Android app and a business dashboard for venues and organizers. Startup project, I work on the whole monorepo and support the team wherever I can. Full stack, live to test.
pulsify.implementText: One monorepo, one API contract. The Hono backend defines every route with Zod schemas, and the Expo app and the Vite dashboard call it through a typed RPC client, so a changed endpoint breaks the consumers at compile time, not in production. DTOs, enums and validation live in a shared package all apps import. Supabase provides auth, Postgres, storage and realtime; only the backend talks to the database (Drizzle) and owns the business logic, the clients never query it directly. The public Next.js site is SEO-first and hands social features off to the native app via deep links. Each app deploys on its own: backend on Railway, web and dashboard on Vercel, the app through EAS.

join.descText: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories. Frontend only.
join.implementText: Kanban board as a single-page app in plain JavaScript. Firebase is the only backend: tasks, contacts and users live as JSON documents, the client reads and writes them over the REST interface and re-renders the affected column. Drag and drop changes only the status field, everything else stays untouched. Design built from the Figma template, responsive down to the phone.

elpolloloco.descText: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen. Two difficult levels, an endless Chicken Rush mode and a top 30 Highscore board.
elpolloloco.implementText: A canvas game on an object-oriented core. One base class draws, animates and moves; characters, enemies and items inherit from it and add their own logic. A central loop checks collisions and drives the animations, a sound object controls all volume in one place. The high score board is the only external dependency: a small REST API that the game reads and writes.

videoflix.descText: Backend for a small video streaming platform. Users register with e-mail and password, activate their account via mail, log in with JWT cookies and stream uploaded videos as HLS in 480p, 720p and 1080p. Backend only, no public deployment yet, see the repository.
videoflix.implementText: Django REST Framework with Simple JWT in HttpOnly cookies, account activation and password reset by mail. PostgreSQL as database, Redis with django-rq for background jobs: every upload triggers ffmpeg jobs that transcode the video into HLS playlists per resolution, a further job grabs the thumbnail. Uploaded thumbnails are validated and re-encoded with Pillow. Mails are sent from the queue as well, so requests never wait for SMTP. Everything runs in Docker Compose (db, redis, web) with an entrypoint that migrates, collects static files and starts the rq worker and gunicorn. Tests for auth and content endpoints.

coderr.descText: Full stack platform for IT services. Business users publish offers with three packages, customers order them and rate the provider afterwards. Full stack project, ready to test live. Hosted on my own netcup server.
coderr.implementText: Django REST Framework API against a given specification. Token authentication with registration and login. Two roles (business and customer) with object level permissions for owner, provider and staff. Nested serializers for offers and their packages, orders that copy the offer conditions, reviews once per provider. Filtering, search, ordering and pagination. Rate limiting per endpoint. Integration tests for the happy path and the 400, 401, 403 and 404 cases. Deployed as a Docker container with gunicorn behind nginx on a Linux vServer that I set up myself.

third.name: Eduard Fray
